description:
## Objective

Add executable application, Plugin, persistence, and durable Agent examples.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U14`
Covers: `R1, R2, R4, R6, R9; KTD1, KTD4, KTD6, KTD8.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.8 (U8) — Add the example catalog harness must be complete; jido-07x.13 (U13) — Port core runtime and topology examples must be complete.
- Unblocks: jido-07x.20 (U20) — Enforce quality gates in CI and agent guidance must be complete.

## Files

Read split core example groups `08_applications/**`, `09_plugins/**`, `10_persistence/**`, and supported `11_durable/**` at the core baseline. Exclude `11_durable/proposals/**`. Add `examples/plugin/**`, `examples/persistence/**`, `examples/durable/**`, and matching tests. Change the manifest.

## Instructions

1. Port supported application, Plugin, persistence, and durable examples.
2. Reuse current persistence test adapters and fixtures.
3. Exclude proposal and research-only examples with manifest reasons.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every source example in the four groups has a manifest disposition.
- [ ] Proposal folders are not presented as supported examples.
- [ ] Persistence examples clean all temporary state.

## Verification

- `mix test.examples test/examples/plugin test/examples/persistence test/examples/durable` exits with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.

comments.text: Completed U14 in commit b1fd539. Added 28 numbered lessons under examples/plugin/08_applications, examples/plugin/09_plugins, examples/persistence/10_persistence, and examples/durable/11_durable with mirrored tests and four durable test helpers. Updated the catalog, source manifest, plan paths, and local links. Excluded durable proposals, shared support trees, and two auxiliary tests with explicit reasons. Verification: focused U14 58 passed with warnings as errors; full examples 226 passed; peer 7 passed and 3728 excluded; catalog 8 passed; source manifest 6 passed; format, link, diff, and no-lib/no-refs checks passed. No supported asset was deferred. Proposal-only 11_08 through 11_19 remain excluded by plan.

title: Port core Plugin and persistence examples
